tui.setting_prune_protect_tokens.b7764ff: Newest tool-result tokens protected from trimming; 0 scales with the model window.
tui.setting_memory_briefing_tokens.c04e6: Hard token limit for the session-start memory briefing.
tui.setting_preflight_repo.b0604569e8: Adds a short repository state to the first message and worker briefings.
tui.setting_fallback_models.649acf7419: Optional provider/model order used after primary backend failure.
tui.setting_fallback_cooldown_seconds.07: How long to skip a backend that failed before its first output.

tui.setting_noop_gate.a1c16ea2ae: Finishes an identical batch task without a model call when nothing changed.
